summary: Keep resume status reads reliable through CPU scheduling pauses while bounding mailbox fault query work to 25 ms of worker CPU time.

replay.detail: Read-only fault capture preserves the same runtime, recovery and snapshot cuts.

schema.detail: No stored data or schema changes.

downtime.detail: No ordering or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: Earlier builds keep their elapsed-time fault-read guard; stored data remains compatible.

compatibility.detail: Under an enclosing request budget, mailbox fault capture limits active work on its blocking reader to 25 ms of CPU time after acquiring the reader. Scheduling and I/O waits remain bounded by the existing request wall deadline. Completed reader work is checked before cleanup; parent cancellation still refuses. There is no retry or longer request deadline. Non-request captures keep their existing 25 ms wall bound. Resource shapes and snapshot semantics are unchanged.
